rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial way to say that a goal can be achieved.

example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 hai6 zou6 dak1 dou2 ge3

rows.note: Use this when attainable means obtainable or something one can get hold of.

example.english: This apartment is attainable if we save enough money.
example.traditional: 呢層樓儲夠錢就攞得到嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 cang4 lau2 cyu5 gau3 cin2 zau6 lo2 dak1 dou2 ge3

rows.note: Use this for a target or standard that can be reached, especially in more formal contexts.

example.traditional: 呢個服務標準係達得到嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 fuk6 mou6 biu1 zeon2 hai6 daat6 dak1 dou2 ge3
